criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Edits user-supplied footage and exposes manual timeline correction, making exact-product retention plausible; first-10-seconds retention and avoidance of substituted B-roll are untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: 4K watermark-free rendering is documented on all paid plans; visual coherence and usable-edit rate are untested.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Editable timeline, turn-by-turn version history, three model tiers and four aspect ratios are documented; repeatability across identical briefs is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Conversational edit, transcript, captions, versions, reframing and editable timeline form a documented end-to-end rough-cut workflow; export interchange and long-project friction are unknown.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: The product demo displays a 12-second turn, but this is a vendor demo rather than controlled timing; queue and failure rate are unknown.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Monthly prices, project/storage limits and credit allocations are documented; per-operation credit burn, trial card requirement and accepted-output cost are unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Terms say uploads stay with the user and license processing only to provide the service; explicit monetized-output rights and third-party model/media rights were not found.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Browser workflow is live; the older YC post describes editing/clipping APIs as future, and no current API, webhook or MCP route was verified.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Self-serve browser product, vertical output and low-entry monthly plan directly fit creator/SMB editing; Australia-specific tax/currency details remain operational rather than use-case uncertainty.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Clear review/comparison search intent and creator workflow relevance; no affiliate programme or tracking route found.

analysis: A differentiated conversational editor with a conventional editable timeline and promising exact-product source-footage fit, but docs-only evidence leaves quality, reliability, credit burn, commercial output rights and automation unresolved.
confidence_notes: Official live product/pricing/terms evidence plus an earlier founder-authored YC launch; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: UNRESOLVED — test exact ASIN visibility in the first 10 seconds and prohibit substituted generic B-roll.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; monetized-output rights and AIVP output evidence missing.
hard_gates.integration: BLOCKED — no current API/MCP route verified; browser account/payment/credit gates require review.
